summary: Both sides included fees in their first-round proposals, and they negotiated fees alongside class relief before agreeing to either. Class counsel considered its firm’s investment, but the transcript does not show it sacrificing class recovery for fees or the defense using fees to reduce class relief. The court declaration accurately describes the timing of the negotiations.
